# Backend 08 full-read review

Ready for root integration and independent audit. Nine complete live entries, 51 questions; 45 exact guarded leaf replacements. No live edits, build, JVM, upload, or publication. All entry identities, question strings/order, anchors, images and hrefs retained. Live entries still match frozen preflight and every guard as of final local validation. Metadata counts and stale N问 labels are untouched for central derivation.

## Material corrections
- Java 21 platform/virtual Thread.run distinction; Thread.stop unsupported in Java 21. Lead and body aligned.
- BoundedPool constructor failure handling no longer contradicts its own start/registration double-decrement warning. Register-before-start is an explicit design requirement, not claimed tested behavior.
- PECS incomplete API sentence repaired in prose; deadlock needs a wait-for cycle, not nontermination alone.
- Detached program/protocol/test-runner references are retained as named conceptual models. No inaccessible implementation or experiment is promised. Numerical cases and failure paths preserved.
- NoteWeave facts confined to verified c60decb1 pom and narrow SDK/HTTP call sites; wider Java/Python design is hypothetical.
- muduo example scoped to inspected v2.0.2 routing and dispatch. Missing v2.0.3 retrieval does not prove nonexistence. Header retrieval failed and is explicitly unresolved in audit.
- Duplicate ordinary-paragraph copies of authored leads removed once; exact authored prefix remains for the actual built renderer. V9 lead changes separately checked.

## Files
`staged-leaf-replacements.json` is the integration payload: entry ID, source path, leaf path, complete before/after strings and SHA-256 guards. `source-span-map.json` supplies precise changed character spans. `*-staged.json` are candidate entries only. `per-entry-dispositions.json` and `*-review.json` document every question and complete HTML section read. `primary-source-audit.json` records official references, versions, verified claims and retrieval limitations. `fact-retention-map.md` lists unique variants. `final-local-validation.json` records live guard, link/anchor/image and authored-prefix checks. `muduo-version-candidate-addendum.json` scans other catalog-selected live entries; candidates are not patches.

## Boundaries
Official references are audit-only, not added to learner prose. No heavy runtime validation was performed. Source wording remains in originals and guarded before values. C++ draft checks are not certification of a libc++ patch; Netty 4.1 API is not a selected deployment patch; Redis 6.2 was not reopened. Independent audit should resolve the explicitly unverified muduo header ownership detail before approving that claim as source-verified.
